description: The line plot illustrates the performance of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) under different expansion strategies on the MS-Marco dev set, measured by MRR@10 as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), which ranges from 1 to 10 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, spans from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Four distinct lines represent different DPR variants: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains constant at approximately 34.3 across all S values; “DPR w/ corpus expansion” (red line with circle markers) starts at 35.2 when S=1, rises steadily to a peak of 35.8 at S=6, then plateaus slightly before ending at 35.8 at S=10; “DPR w/ document expansion” (green line with triangle markers) begins at 34.8, dips slightly to 34.7 at S=3, then gradually increases to 34.9 at S=6 before stabilizing around 34.8–34.9 through S=10; and “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” (blue line with star markers) starts at 34.8, peaks at 35.0 at S=2, drops to 34.6 at S=6, and continues declining to 34.4 at S=10. All lines are plotted with markers at integer S values, and the legend is positioned in the lower right corner.
